# runpod_endpoint_builds (Data Source)

Container builds of a Serverless endpoint built from a Git repository. Empty for an endpoint that deploys a prebuilt image.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runpod_endpoint_builds" "vllm" {
  endpoint_id = "ep_abc123"
}

output "build_statuses" {
  description = "Build state per build."
  value       = { for b in data.runpod_endpoint_builds.vllm.builds : b.id => b.status }
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this data source live in the
use-case modules under `v2/modules/` in the provider repository; the Guides
section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint_id` (String) Serverless endpoint identifier.

### Read-Only

- `builds` (Attributes List) One entry per build. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--builds))

<a id="nestedatt--builds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `builds`

Read-Only:

- `branch` (String) Git branch the build came from.
- `commit_date` (String) Commit timestamp in RFC 3339 format.
- `commit_hash` (String) Git commit the build came from.
- `commit_message` (String) Commit message of the built commit.
- `completed_at` (String) Build finish timestamp in RFC 3339 format; null while it is still running.
- `error` (String) Failure detail; null unless the build failed.
- `id` (String) Build identifier.
- `image_name` (String) Image the build produced; null until it completes.
- `started_at` (String) Build start timestamp in RFC 3339 format.
- `status` (String) Build state: PENDING, BUILDING, UPLOADING, TESTING, COMPLETED, FAILED, TEST_FAILED, or CANCELLED.
